Aksar Poochhe Jaate Hain

Aapke Sawaal,
Hamare Jawaab

Koi bhi sawaal ho toh seedhe hum se poochh sakte hain — lekin neeche ke sawaal sabse zyada poochhe jaate hain.

Seedha Poochhen
Bilkul nahi. Hamare doodh mein pani, starch, urea ya koi bhi chemical nahi milaya jaata. Aap khud ghar par lactometer test karke dekh sakte hain. 100% guaranteed shuddh.
Haan, 365 din — chaahe barsaat ho, thand ho ya garmi. Subah 5–7 baje hum aapke darwaze par hote hain. Koi chutti nahi, koi bahana nahi.
Doodh ke liye minimum 500ml. Ghee ke liye 250gm. Paneer ke liye 500gm. Bulk orders ke liye koi minimum nahi — seedhe baat karein.
Cash, UPI (PhonePe, GooglePay, Paytm) — sab accepted hai. Monthly settlement bhi ho sakta hai regular customers ke liye. Pehle hafte trial mein koi advance nahi.
Hum Delhuan, Chitaon Panchayat aur aas-paas ke Kochas-Dinara areas mein delivery karte hain. Call karke confirm kar lein ki aapka area covered hai.
